description: Payload contract for the generated deliverable data/analysis/<song>/song_event_timeline.json, produced by the phase-3 gestures stage (src/analyzer/stages/gestures.py, plan v3.0 item 9). Replaces the Epic-5 song_event_schema (composite build/drop/post_drop rows with nested phases[], member_event_ids, lighting_hint, evidence_ref) -- that stack was measured at chance against the gold set and deleted in the same change. Nothing in src/ loads this file at runtime any more -- it is documentation of the contract.

event.description: One flat row per gesture phase or per section-pair transition -- never a composite with nested sub-phases. See event_vocabulary.json for the two `type` shapes.
event.type_enum_note: Either a gesture phase name from event_vocabulary.json's phase_vocabulary (approach, build, tension, impact, release), or a '<from_label> → <to_label>' section-pair transition.
event.summary_note: Natural descriptive prose, e.g. 'a rising riser builds into an impact here'. Must never equal any retired Epic-5 boilerplate string (constitution §2 -- no internal implementation notes leak into a projected field).

removed_in_v3_0_item_9.description: The composite-row shape (composite, phases[], member_event_ids, evidence_ref, lighting_hint, created_by, id) and the layer_add/layer_remove per-beat delta events and texture_summary[] are gone. Every event this stage emits is already flat and already carries its own evidence_summary; there is no separate machine-events file to cross-reference.
